details:
This update for python-Brotli fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-6176: denial of service (DoS) due to a flaw in its brotli decompression (bsc#1252945).
- CVE-2026-111497: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write permits remote code execution (bsc#1287779).

Update to 1.2.1:

- **decoder / encoder: added static initialization to reduce binary size**
- python: allow limiting decoder output (see SECURITY section)
- python: modernize extension / allow multi-phase module initialization
- decoder / encoder: static tables use "small" model (allows 2GiB+ binaries)
